Last updated: 2026-05-30 Maintained by: Travis Burandt Sources of truth: ampersand-nav/src/amp-nav.js (LINKS table = canonical URLs), sync-nav.sh (deploy targets), STACK_COMPLETION.md (status/tier). Update this file when a page is added/removed or a domain changes.

Status/tier come from STACK_COMPLETION.md via the nav's {status, tier} pairs. tier ∈ shipped | alpha | spec. Pages listed are the static HTML surfaces actually present in the repo (build artifacts, old_scrap/, and app bundles excluded).

Research — The Arithmetic Ladder (box-and-box governance kernel)

The eight-rung modality ladder + composing bridge, 116 property-tested laws (103 kernel + 13 compose/CC2). The npm package is pure library (code only); the rung pages live at the opensentience.org root. The verdict surface is a CLI/library (box-and-box govern decision.json → certificate JSON, CI exit codes); an MCP adapter is a planned-but-unbuilt optional surface. The full reference implementation (JS engine + Elixir host) is browsable/downloadable at the served mirror opensentience.org/box-and-box/.

3. Repo → deploy reference (amp-nav distribution)

How sync-nav.sh deploys the shared <amp-nav> web component (one source: ampersand-nav/dist/amp-nav.js). Mirrors the stack-type categories the script uses.

StackReposamp-nav deploy path
Static HTMLagentromatic, delegatic, deliberatic, geofleetic, graphonomous.com, ticktickclock<site>/amp-nav.js
SvelteKitbendscript, runefort.com<site>/static/amp-nav.js (+ root if index.html)
Elixir/Phoenixagentelic, fleetprompt, opensentience.org, specprompt<site>/amp-nav.js + <site>/priv/static/amp-nav.js
Extra targetsrepo-root, AmpersandBoxDesign/site, AmpersandBoxDesign/protocol, PULSE/site, PRISM/priv/static/assets, WebHost.Systems (+ apps/web), workbench/app/static(per EXTRA_TARGETS in sync-nav.sh)

Total: 12 sites + 8 extra targets = 20 amp-nav deploy locations.
